entities.name: Rabbitfolk
entities.description: A common type of animalfolk in the Valley of Bloomburrow, community-focused chefs and farmers who are conflict-averse but protect their homes.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The region of Bloomburrow where the animalfolk live.

entities.name: Pawpatch Party
entities.description: A group of powerful, trained rabbitfolk warriors who patrol the Valley to protect it from Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Dangerous beasts that threaten the Valley.

entities.name: Flower Garden
entities.description: A sacred site to the rabbitfolk of Valley, its path curated for centuries so that no flower is trampled.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: A rabbitfolk who assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A character whose quest was to stop the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Fluffles
entities.description: The large families around which rabbitfolk lives revolve.
